chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Sonny Clay and the four main Los Angeles bands
summary: Howard calls Sonny Clay a pianist and arranger; he confirms Howard, Clay, Reb Spikes and Curtis Moseby had the main bands but never competed.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
